components.name: Course facts panel
components.description: Peach definition-list container for actual course facts; not a generic catalog card.
components.html:
體驗費用
NT$1,800／人

四小時

費用包含：至少三種豆實作、SOP 學習卡、筆記講義與 100g 上課豆。
components.css: .ds-facts{font-family:var(--body,Huninn,'PingFang TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif);font-weight:400;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ink,#443a34);padding:30px 34px;background:var(--peach,#f4dfce);border-radius:16px}.ds-facts dl{margin:0}.ds-facts dl>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr;gap:20px;border-bottom:1px solid #ccb9a7;padding:16px 0;font-size:18px}.ds-facts dl>div:first-child{padding-top:0}.ds-facts dt{color:#655448}.ds-facts dd{margin:0}.ds-facts p{font-size:17px;margin:22px 0 0}.ds-facts strong{font-weight:400;color:var(--blue,#28536a)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-facts{padding:24px}.ds-facts dl>div{grid-template-columns:75px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px}}

components.name: Native FAQ disclosure
components.description: Working native disclosure with an inline plus that rotates on open.
components.html:
完全沒有經驗，可以參加嗎？

可以，從認識器材、拿壺、注水到品飲，一步步陪你練。
components.css: .ds-faq{font-family:var(--body,Huninn,'PingFang TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif);font-weight:400;color:var(--ink,#443a34);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d8d4c8)}.ds-faq summary{list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:21px;cursor:pointer;padding:22px 0;line-height:1.65}.ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-faq svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--blue,#28536a);transition:transform .2s}.ds-faq[open] summary{color:var(--blue,#28536a)}.ds-faq[open] svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-faq summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#28536a);outline-offset:5px;}.ds-faq>div{padding:0 40px 24px 0;color:var(--muted,#6a6059);font-size:18px;line-height:1.85}.ds-faq p{margin:0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-text svg,.ds-faq svg,.ds-parameter button{transition:none}}

components.name: Parameter selector states
components.description: Actual four-button visual pattern with one pressed state. Full lesson switching requires assets/site.js; this preview is intentionally a state sample.
components.css: .ds-parameter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));border-bottom:1px solid #8eabb4;gap:8px;background:var(--sky,#dceef5);font-family:var(--body,Huninn,'PingFang TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif);font-weight:400;}.ds-parameter button{font-family:var(--body,Huninn,'PingFang TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif);font-weight:400;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:16px 4px 18px;min-height:90px;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;color:#456171;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}.ds-parameter svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;width:30px;height:30px}.ds-parameter button:hover{background:#fffdf644}.ds-parameter button[aria-pressed=true]{border-bottom-color:var(--blue,#28536a);color:var(--blue,#28536a);background:#fffdf666}.ds-parameter button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#28536a);outline-offset:5px;}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-parameter{gap:4px}.ds-parameter button{font-size:15px;padding:12px 0 16px;gap:9px;min-height:88px}.ds-parameter svg{width:27px;height:27px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-text svg,.ds-faq svg,.ds-parameter button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A warm, simple coffee workshop world: rounded readable lettering, cream paper, Logo-derived sky blue and cocoa ink. Open information rows and generous breathing room make a substantial beginner course approachable. Genuine classroom and instructor photographs sit alongside restrained observational pencil sketches of brewing, home practice and tasting notes, without anthropomorphic faces. Bean-sales introductions use the supplied Ruru packaging design reference, visibly labeled as illustrative rather than actual product specifications.

This documents only the independent local `warm-workshop` prototype. It is extracted from `assets/style.css`, `assets/site.js`, `index.html` and `beans.html`, with `PRODUCT.md` and `design/direction.md` supplying confirmed identity context. The build is code-led; there is no approved visual comp. It does not replace any production design system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and light blue, with dark readable type.
One locally hosted rounded typeface across Chinese and English.
Real people and original illustrative coffee companions.
Open rows, quiet dividers and selective colored panels.
Native controls, visible focus and modest motion.

rules.name: The Reading Ink Rule
rules.body: Use cocoa or deep blue for readable content on pastel surfaces; pale fills organize the page rather than replacing dark text.

rules.name: The Comfortable Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve the actual 19px desktop and 18px phone body sizes with 1.85 leading; captions remain a distinct supporting role.

dos: **Do** preserve the original blue/cream Logo and locally hosted Huninn.
**Do** keep body text at 19px on desktop and 18px on phones, with generous leading.
**Do** pair authentic people photographs with original illustrations and identify illustrative situations honestly.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, native disclosure semantics and reduced-motion support.
**Do** use the existing LINE inquiry destination for course and bean actions.
donts: **Don't** replace real instructor or classroom evidence with generated people.
**Don't** present flavor illustrations as ingredients or practice illustrations as actual packaging.
**Don't** treat derived sidecar ramps as implemented CSS tokens.
**Don't** turn the current hero order or open-row composition into a prohibition on future surface layouts.
